I answered Marcus in his DM: his go-to escalation contact at Tamsin Cold Chain is Elodie Ashdown. He told me himself in this same DM on Oct 14 that she's his contact for the Ironbridge rollout from now on. So I could give it back to him here, and it didn't go anywhere else.

**Possible privacy problem:** in gbrain, Marcus's private DMs are saved as facts 5, 7, 8 and 12. Each one is marked `visibility: "world"`, even though it's stored under his private source. If the brain uses that marking, other members could see his DMs. I haven't changed or deleted anything. To hide them, fact 5 is the one with his original message.
